biblioteca.gui.looping_config.title: Per-Dimension Attributes
biblioteca.sky_light.disabled.descriptio: No sky light; block lights still work.
biblioteca.sky_light.looping.description: Direct sky requires a transparent column through the entire vertical loop. Light propagates across the boundary.
biblioteca.sky_light.hybrid.description: Direct sky uses vanilla exposure: unobstructed from this cell to the dimension's top. Light propagation and sampling still wrap across the boundary.
biblioteca.gui.looping_config.note: You can also change these settings using /biblioteca while playing.
